faqs.q: How do I track my daily workouts?
faqs.a: Go to Dashboard > Today and tap Start on the workout card to begin and log your exercises.

faqs.q: How do I edit my profile summary?
faqs.a: Open Settings > Profile and you can update your physical details and fitness goals.

faqs.q: How can I contact my trainer?
faqs.a: Use the Chats tab in the main navigation to send messages and share progress with your coach.

faqs.q: What happens if I miss a meal?
faqs.a: You can log it later, or adjust your next meal. Consistency is key, not perfection!
